meta.name: analyze-project
meta.description: Rigor Analyze / Rigor Audit read-only skill for deep learning research repositories. Use when the user wants to read and understand a repository, inspect model structure and training or inference entrypoints, review configs and insertion points, or flag suspicious implementation patterns without modifying code or running heavy jobs. Do not use for active command execution, broad refactoring, speculative code adaptation, or automatic bug fixing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查深度学习代码库,理清结构与关键入口,标出可疑实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接手深度学习研究代码,想先搞清结构与风险点。
copy.tagline_en: Read deep-learning repositories and flag suspicious patterns.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to understand a deep-learning research codebase before making changes.

howto.what: 让它以只读方式读懂深度学习研究仓库:梳理模型结构、训练与推理入口、配置关系,把可疑写法标为启发式。在 analysis_outputs/ 下产出 SUMMARY.md、RISKS.md、status.json,不改动代码。
howto.when: 当你想先读懂某个深度学习仓库、需要模型结构与训练/推理入口的地图,或明确要求只读分析而不跑重任务时触发。

say.text: 只读分析这个仓库,给我模型结构、训练和推理入口的地图
看看这个项目里有没有可疑的实现写法,标成启发式别当结论
检查一下配置和可能的插入点,不要改代码

howto.what_en: Read-only review of deep learning repos: maps model structure, training/inference entrypoints and config links, marking suspicious patterns as heuristics. Writes SUMMARY.md, RISKS.md, status.json under analysis_outputs/; no code patches.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to understand a deep learning repository, need a map of model structure and training/inference entrypoints, or ask for read-only analysis without heavy execution.

say_en.text: Read this repo read-only; map model structure, training/inference entrypoints
Flag suspicious implementation patterns in this project as heuristics only
Check the configs and likely insertion points, without changing code
